title: GitLab fails to detect Linux docker version
author: xasc

comments.author: Thf772
comments.body:
This isn't a Gitlab-specific issue, though I also have it on Gitlab. The problem is caused by Docker CLI client version 29 (which replaces the key for API version as @henryiii pointed out).

As a temporary workaround, I've replaced `curl -sSL https://get.docker.com/ | sh` in my CI file with this:
```
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o get-docker.sh && sh ./get-docker.sh --version 28 && rm get-docker.sh
```
This will always install the latest Docker client with major version 28, which didn't break the JSON version output.

comments.author: Jonatan-Rydberg-work-account
comments.body:
I confirm that version v3.3.0 fixed the problem for our team.

We used docker image docker:dind (58cdce60b4d9), which is based on Alpine Linux version 3.22.2.

```
pip show cibuildwheel
Name: cibuildwheel
Version: 3.3.0
Summary: Build Python wheels on CI with minimal configuration.
Home-page: https://github.com/pypa/cibuildwheel
Author:
Author-email: Joe Rickerby <joerick@mac.com>
License-Expression: BSD-2-Clause
Location: /wrk/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages
Requires: bashlex, bracex, build, certifi, dependency-groups, filelock, humanize, packaging, patchelf, platformdirs, pyelftools, wheel
Required-by:
```
